text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, an invitation arrived for Biko 
Pegasus, so we came to the designated 
location.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Is this... a park...?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hello, Justice Biko! Do you remember me?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The girl who exchanged a vow of 
victory with me! So it was you who sent 
the invitation!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Justice Biko kept her promise fair 
and square!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"So, today, we want Biko— to watch our 
hero show!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're gonna put on a hero show for 
us!? I wanna watch, I wanna watch!!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Well then, take a seat right 
there! "Hero of the Turf" is about to 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My name is Biko Pegasus! Running to become 
a hero of justice, the stroooongest 
Umamusume around!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Trainer, that's me! That kid is 
acting as me!?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer and I trained super hard 
together, and I got crazy fast! I'm not 
gonna lose tomorrow's race!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Leading the pack right now is Hishi 
Akebono! Making an early move, she's 
pulling away from the rest! Is Biko 
Pegasus blocked up front!?

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ I'll give it my all~! I'll win and 
deliver a buono smile to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it! I'm boxed in by the big ones! 
At this rate, I can't break out――!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is bad?! No way! Don't give up, 
me!!

text_block_list.name: Drama Club Members
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Don't lose, Biko! Bi-ko! 
Bi-ko! Bi-ko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bi-ko! Bi-ko! Bi-ko!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, right as cheers for Biko Pegasus 
erupted throughout the park—the little 
girl playing Biko dashed off at tremendous 
speed!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"I can hear everyone's voices cheering me 
on... My heart is racing! Power is surging 
through my legs!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
That's right! A hero never backs down in 
any situation!! If I'm small, I'll just 
use that to my advantage—!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Now's the time! —Uooooooh! Pegasus Mach 
Striiiike!!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
So fast!? Biko Pegasus bursts through from 
the middle of the pack—and swoops in for 
the win! Taking first place is Biko 
Pegasuuuus!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The play continued after that, and Biko 
Pegasus laughed happily watching a show 
where he was the star—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: How was it? Was our hero show exciting?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It was sooo, sooo amazing!!! Remembering 
the race got my blood pumping all over 
again! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I just really wanted to express 
how I felt when Biko gave me courage!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you stand tall without flinching 
against such an amazing opponent warmed my 
heart! It gave me the courage to fight, 
too...!!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: So, thank you! My hero, Justice Biko!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Aah!! Keep on cheering for me, alright? 
As a hero, I'll live up to everyone's 
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved her goal, Biko Pegasus 
received a wonderful present.
